content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Ebooks online

Sovereign commerce infrastructure is ownership of your digital sales stack. No platform dependence. No subscriptions. No geographic restrictions. It’s GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery. Payment processing is on-chain via NOWPayments—300+ [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/crypto-payments-tanzanian-online-sellers-which-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-architecture-behind-selling-design-assets-crypto-payments-4|COREMERCH guide to architecture]]-actually-3|Crypto Payments]]currencies, 0.5% fee, no KYC. This architecture bypasses Stripe’s country exclusions and PayPal’s fund holds. You own the code. You control the data. You deploy once, sell forever.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The stack is modular. Frontend: Static site hosted on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Backend: Serverless functions via Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handle order logic. Database: Supabase or Google Sheets logs transactions. File delivery: Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 stores and serves your ebooks, courses, or templates. Payment: NOWPayments verifies crypto transactions on-chain. Webhook triggers file delivery the moment payment confirms. No third-party APIs. No platform lock-in. Every component is free or low-cost. You pay only the 0.5% transaction fee to NOWPayments. The infrastructure is stateless—no servers to manage, no domains to renew. Deploy, configure, sell.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This is for digital creators in regions where conventional payment processors are unavailable or unreliable. Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Ethiopia, Venezuela, Zimbabwe, Cameroon, Tanzania, Philippines—these are the pressure-tested markets. If Stripe rejects your country, if PayPal suspends your account, if Gumroad locks you out, this stack is your alternative. It’s for creators selling ebooks, courses, fonts, presets, beats, plugins, software, and digital products. It’s for those who want infrastructure sovereignty—not renting, but owning. No platform can shut you down. No algorithm can demonetize you. This is commerce built on your terms.
Stripe operates in only 46 of 195 countries. This stack works in all of them.
The Components That Make It Work Together

GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages provide static hosting—free, fast, globally distributed. Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handle backend logic without servers. Supabase or Google Sheets store order data securely. Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 deliver files instantly. NOWPayments processes crypto payments with a 0.5% fee, no KYC, and automatic webhooks. The stack is integrated via webhooks and APIs. Payment confirmation triggers file delivery. Order data is logged. The customer receives their product. You retain full data ownership. No platform touches your funds or your customer list. This is base-layer infrastructure—permanent, portable, and platform-independent.

Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use this stack if I’m in Nigeria, Ghana, or Pakistan?

Yes. This stack is designed for creators in regions where Stripe, PayPal, and other platforms are unavailable or unreliable. It uses globally accessible tools like GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Workers, and NOWPayments. Deploy and sell from anywhere.
What cryptocurrencies does NOWPayments support?

NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, including Bitcoin, Ethereum, Binance Coin, and stablecoins like USDT. Recommended networks for low fees are BSC, Solana, and TRON—under $0.10 per transaction.
Do I need to manage servers or domains?

No. The stack is stateless and serverless. GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages handle hosting. Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script manage backend logic. No servers, no domains, no recurring fees. Deploy once, sell forever.
What happens if NOWPayments goes down?

NOWPayments is a payment processor, not a platform. If it fails, replace it with another crypto gateway. The stack is modular—swap components without rebuilding. You own the code and data. No platform lock-in.
Can I scale this stack as my business grows?

Yes. The architecture is designed for scalability. Cloudflare Pages and Workers handle high traffic. Supabase scales with your database needs. Add more products, increase transaction volume, and expand globally. This is enterprise-grade infrastructure for digital creators.
Own your infrastructure. Deploy once. Sell forever. No platform can shut you down.
